objective: Capture every architectural write to all 32 bytes of the exact selected prepare_layer x19+656 aggregate from its latest zero epoch through its later exact-source marker, without requiring x28 to carry its future identity and without allowing a hardware watchpoint to outlive the watched frame.

openedEvidenceBoundary.conclusion: The sealed sampled gate passed exactly, but top-frame operand addresses prove both apply_transform callbacks and the sampled unapply_transform callback target temporary rectangles at aggregate+752 or aggregate+912. Only the union_bounds callbacks target the aggregate directly. The aggregate changes between sampled callbacks 141 and 142 while callback 142's destination is aggregate+912, proving an uninstrumented causal mutation remains.

alreadyOpenedArithmetic.glassUVSpan: q times the allocated backdrop extent
alreadyOpenedArithmetic.effectiveOrigin: producer-pass crop-transform origin plus copy-base signed integer offset
alreadyOpenedArithmetic.scope: These relationships are exact over opened samples. They do not identify every CPU writer instruction, independently predict the discrete allocation producer, or establish unseen transfer.

captureDesign.inheritedCapture: Import and run the immutable frame-correlated harness in the same LLDB target, preserving its independent source selection, complete prepare_layer and union_bounds hashes, nine sampled sites, exact frame selection, and sealed validator as an inherited gate.
captureDesign.entryGate: At a separate exact prepare_layer entry callback, require the exact 40,128-byte symbol and frozen full-code SHA-256, then require the frozen instructions at +0xb5c, +0x2a68, and +0x3ef0 before the first invocation resumes.
captureDesign.epochArmRule: After the independent source is known, retain +0xb60 only when the bounded live backtrace contains exactly four exact prepare_layer frames. The current identity is (thread ID, x19 role base, x29 frame pointer); x28 is deliberately not an early identity field.
captureDesign.fullAggregateCoverage: Install four simultaneous aligned write-only hardware watchpoints of 8 bytes at aggregate offsets 0, 8, 16, and 24. Together they cover every byte of x19+656 through x19+687 without gaps or overlap.
captureDesign.watchRecord: For every hardware stop whose exact live prepare_layer ancestry contains the armed identity, retain the triggering lane and watchpoint, full 32-byte before and after aggregate, changed-lane set, exact top frame and bounded backtrace, matched prepare frame and registers, complete 2 KiB role, a PC-containing 4 KiB code window, and—on a change—all scalar and SIMD registers, 2 KiB stack, pointer probes, selected objects, and private fields.
captureDesign.continuityRule: Zero ignored hits are allowed. For each armed group, the first event before-state must equal the epoch aggregate and every later event before-state must equal the preceding after-state, including duplicate hardware callbacks from a multi-lane store.
captureDesign.lifetimeRule: At recursive prepare return +0x2a68, delete all four watchpoints as soon as the watched identity disappears from the exact live prepare_layer ancestry. A repeated depth-four zero epoch retires and replaces the previous group. No watchpoint may remain attached to an expired stack frame.
captureDesign.selectionRule: At the first +0x3ef0 frame whose x28 equals the independently selected source, require recursion depth four and exact active thread/x19/x29 identity, select its latest epoch and every qualified event in that group, then delete the watches.
captureDesign.closureRule: Require an all-zero selected epoch, at least three changed hardware transitions, at least four distinct full aggregate states, a contiguous chain, final 32-byte equality with both the active marker and inherited sampled marker, and at least one changed stop PC outside the nine sampled after-sites.
captureDesign.semanticSeal: The gate may prove the complete causal writer-PC sequence and exact full-aggregate state chain only. It may not decode the newly opened instructions, generalize the crop policy, establish unseen transfer, authorize a production shader change, or claim parity.
captureDesign.nullOutcome: Any source-selection failure, code or marker drift, recursion-depth mismatch, inability to allocate all four hardware watchpoints, stale or ignored hit, watch deletion failure, record truncation, discontinuity, fewer than three changed transitions, fewer than four distinct states, absent newly opened changed PC, final marker mismatch, debugger failure, stopped target, inherited-validator failure, or existing allocation/inputClamp failure fails closed while preserving the artifact.
